name: Galangal

low.description: About 1 tablespoon fresh grated or sliced

siboNotes: Galangal is well-tolerated in typical culinary amounts and may have anti-inflammatory properties that could benefit digestive health.
preparationTips: Use fresh galangal sparingly - a little goes a long way for flavor
Peel and grate or slice thinly for cooking, or pound in a mortar and pestle
Can be frozen whole and grated directly from frozen
Dried galangal powder is more concentrated - use even smaller amounts
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds
Contains galangin, a flavonoid with potential health benefits
Good source of vitamin C and iron
